justification.acceleration_tracking: Eliminates steady-state acceleration lag; error drops from 10.42 px to 0.76 px (92.7% reduction).
justification.lead_prediction: Superior lead-angle extrapolation at control latencies 20-100 ms (5.86 px vs 13.14 px).
justification.maneuver_retention: T10 coast frames reduced from 14 (0.28s) to 0 (0.00s), maintaining 100% track availability.

tradeoffs_and_constraints.long_horizon_extrapolation: Extrapolation past 350 ms exhibits crossover on turning/orbital paths due to quadratic acceleration projection; lead-ahead horizons should be capped at <= 200 ms.
tradeoffs_and_constraints.t07_dropout_traversal: During total beacon optical extinction, an intersecting distractor will be transiently tracked for 0.34s before instant recovery to true beacon on frame 20; this is a consequence of line-of-sight intersection and cannot be solved without truth leakage.
